final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(s.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share
